name: Wingu Africa Dar es Salaam Data Centre (Mbezi)
notes: First carrier-neutral Tier III data centre and cable landing station in Tanzania; Phase 1 launched mid-2022 at Mbezi Beach industrial area (Dar es Salaam); Phase 2 expansion (US$50m, groundbreaking Mar 2025 per DCD) takes campus to 3MW; TIX internet exchange extended to the facility; direct access to SEACOM, EASSy and 2Africa at Dar es Salaam, Zanzibar and Tanga; tenants include Vodacom, Tigo, Halotel, Liquid Intelligent Technologies.

name: Raxio TZ1 Data Centre (Dar es Salaam)
notes: Country's first carrier-neutral Tier III data centre (Raxio TZ1); 6MW IT power, 800 racks, 4,000m2 white space, scalable to double floor; 33kV utility supply from nearest substation, 2N power; launch targeted for 2026 per official Raxio page (earlier dates 2024/2025 slipped).

name: National Internet Data Center (NIDC) - TTCL
notes: National Internet Data Center operated by state-owned TTCL at Mikocheni (1 Wizara Close), Dar es Salaam; provides national colocation/hosting for government and enterprise.

name: TTCL Telephone House Data Center
notes: Legacy TTCL data centre at Kaluta Street, Dar es Salaam city centre; small/medium colocation facility.

name: Vodacom Business Data Centre (Dar es Salaam)
notes: Vodacom Business enterprise data centre in Dar es Salaam; a 12MW figure circulates in aggregate lists (systalink/africanexponent) but is unverified - left capacity null; datacentermap lists 11 Tanzanian facilities across 6 operators, most in Dar es Salaam.

name: Yas (Tigo) Salasala Data Center
notes: Former Tigo Tanzania data centre on Salasala Road, Dar es Salaam; Tigo rebranded to Yas as part of Axian Telecom's pan-African rebranding.

name: Continuum Datacenter
notes: Local cloud/virtual-server hosting and datacenter solutions provider at Kibasila Street, Dar es Salaam; small domestic colo/hosting provider.

name: Microsoft Azure East Africa region (Kenya & Tanzania)
notes: Microsoft announced plans (May 2023) for its first East Africa cloud region spanning Kenya and Tanzania, with Tanzanian facilities expected in Dar es Salaam; no confirmed construction as of Aug 2026; the Kenya leg (US$1bn Microsoft/G42 project, May 2024) reported delayed over capacity-payment guarantees (Bloomberg, May 2026); Tanzania component status uncertain.

name: Vodacom Business Data Centre (Dodoma)
notes: Vodacom Business data centre on Lusinde Road, Dodoma; the only commercial data centre listed for Dodoma on datacentermap.

name: National Government Data Centre (Dodoma)
developer: Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology (Tanzania)
notes: Announced in FY2024/25 ministry budget speech (May 2024): construction of data centres in Dodoma and Zanzibar plus a national information security centre; linked to e-Government Authority (eGA) government hosting infrastructure.

name: Zanzibar e-Government Authority (eGAZ) Data Centre
notes: Government data centre in Zanzibar (Zanzibar City / Urban West area; Zanzibar North used as closest division in this batch); eGAZ hosts public-sector websites and e-services; World Bank assessment notes eGAZ shares a data centre with Zanzibar's Ministry of Communication and the mainland eGovernment Authority, constraining expansion.

name: Zanzibar Government Data Centre (planned)
developer: Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology (Tanzania) / Zanzibar government
notes: New Zanzibar data centre announced in FY2024/25 ministry budget (May 2024) as part of the two data centre build programme (Dodoma + Zanzibar); status/progress since not publicly confirmed.
